info.name: APIs.io Engineering Platform Amazon API Gateway 2014 11 13 Forks API
APIs.io Engineering Platform Create a fork

params.name: collectionId
params.description: The collection's ID.

params.name: workspace
params.description: The workspace ID in which to create the fork.

items.docs: Creates a [fork](https://learning.postman.com/docs/collaborating-in-postman/version-control/#creating-a-fork) from an existing collection into a workspace.

info.name: APIs.io Engineering Platform Merge a fork

items.docs: Merges a forked collection back into its parent collection. You must have the [Editor role](https://learning.postman.com/docs/collaborating-in-postman/roles-and-permissions/#collection-roles) for the collection to merge a fork.

info.name: APIs.io Engineering Platform Get all forked collections

params.name: collectionId
params.description: The collection's ID.

params.name: cursor
params.description: The pointer to the first record of the set of paginated results. To view the next response, use the `nextCursor` value for this parameter.

params.name: limit
params.description: The maximum number of rows to return in the response.

params.name: direction
params.description: Sort the results by creation date in ascending (`asc`) or descending (`desc`) order.

items.docs: Gets a list of all the authenticated user's forked collections.

info.name: APIs.io Engineering Platform Get a collection's forks

params.name: collectionId
params.description: The collection's ID.

params.name: cursor
params.description: The pointer to the first record of the set of paginated results. To view the next response, use the `nextCursor` value for this parameter.

params.name: limit
params.description: The maximum number of rows to return in the response.

params.name: direction
params.description: Sort the results by creation date in ascending (`asc`) or descending (`desc`) order.

items.docs: Gets a collection's forked collections. The response returns data for each fork, such as the fork's ID, the user who forked it, and the fork's creation date.

info.name: APIs.io Engineering Platform Pull source changes

params.name: collectionId
params.description: The collection's ID.

items.docs:
Pulls the changes from a parent (source) collection into the forked collection. In the endpoint's response:

- The `destinationId` is the ID of the forked collection.
- The `sourceId` is the ID of the source collection.

info.name: APIs.io Engineering Platform Get source collection's status

params.name: collectionId
params.description: The collection's ID.

items.docs:
Checks whether there is a change between the forked collection and its parent (source) collection.

If the value of the `isSourceAhead` property is `true` in the response, then there is a difference between the forked collection and its source collection.

**Note:**

This endpoint may take a few minutes to return an updated `isSourceAhead` status.
